Projects.title: Projects
Projects.subtitle: Some of the projects I have worked on
Projects.plannerDescription: Internal web application for planning and managing tasks and technicians.

plannerDetails.description: Internal application focused on technician planning and daily task management. I have worked on both frontend and backend features related to the calendar, tasks, conflicts, clients, users and vacations.
plannerDetails.myWorkDescription: Development of both frontend and backend features across different areas of the application.

calendar.title: Calendar and tasks
calendar.description: Development and improvement of features related to task planning and management.
features: Cloning tasks across different time slots.
Warnings when creating tasks on past dates.
Marking and unmarking tasks as completed.

conflicts.title: Conflict resolution
conflicts.description: System for detecting and resolving conflicts between tasks and users before completing an operation.
features: Identification of the task causing the conflict.
Ability to remove users from conflicting tasks.
Applying the resolution once all conflicts have been managed.
Support for creating, moving, cloning, resizing and modifying tasks.

clients.title: Clients and users
clients.description: Development of features for managing clients and users, including forms, validations, search and sorting.
features: Email, phone, NIF and IBAN validation.
Unified search for clients and systems.
Dynamic sorting of clients and users.
Improvements and fixes in user management.

vacations.title: Vacations and absences
vacations.description: Integration of vacation and absence management with task planning.
features: Detection of conflicts between vacations and tasks.
Protection of tasks related to absences.

ux.title: User experience
ux.description: Improvements aimed at making the application clearer, more consistent and easier to use.
features: Improvements to the task reading dialog.
Fixes for display and overflow issues.
Visual improvements to tables and the calendar.

conflictSystem.title: Conflict system
conflictSystem.description: Interactive system for detecting and resolving planning conflicts before completing an operation.

dailySummary.title: Daily summary
dailySummary.description: Centralized view to check a technician's tasks and their status for a specific day.

vacationManagement.title: Vacation management
vacationManagement.description: Integration between vacations, absences and planning to prevent assignment conflicts.

clientManagement.title: Client management
clientManagement.description: Client profiles with validations, unified search and additional information management.
